query: INSERT INTO user_settings (user_id, theme_preference, language_preference, title_language_preference, accent_preference, timezone, reminder_offsets_minutes) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET theme_preference = EXCLUDED.theme_preference, language_preference = EXCLUDED.language_preference, title_language_preference = EXCLUDED.title_language_preference, accent_preference = EXCLUDED.accent_preference, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, reminder_offsets_minutes = EXCLUDED.reminder_offsets_minutes
